invariants.rationale: The method unconditionally throws an exception, so no return value is ever assigned.
The program point is unreachable due to the unconditional throw; any invariant trivially holds.
Method parameters are required for invocation, especially the context object.
Method parameter should not be null for compaction logic (even if unused here).

invariants.expression: throw new HoodieNotSupportedException("Compaction is not supported on a CopyOnWrite table") != null
invariants.rationale: The throw statement always interrupts control flow; this expression is included for completeness.
